dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Is the swimming pool open now?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ɪz ðə ˈswɪmɪŋ ˌpuːl ˈoʊpən ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry, you can't swim here now. It opens at ten.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, juː ˈkænt ˈswɪm ˈhɪr ˈnaʊ. ɪt ˈoʊpənz ət ˈtɛn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, you can. The trash can is over there.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, juː ˈkæn. ðə ˈtræʃ ˌkæn ɪz ˌoʊvər ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great! Let's sit on the grass, Nam.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ˈlɛts ˈsɪt ɑːn ðə ˈɡræs, ˈnɑːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We can't. It says "Keep off the grass."
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈkænt. ɪt ˈsɛz "ˈkiːp ˈɔːf ðə ˈɡræs."
